identity_preservation: Preserve recognizable face and major facial structure
Preserve core facial proportions and face shape

character.decision: Use the age-20 identity reference as the dominant conditioning signal; allow natural expression changes without altering identity.
character.gate: Reject wrong face, apparent age drift, altered eye color, incorrect hair color, excessive makeup, plastic skin, or facial over-smoothing.

clothing.decision: Use refined Japanese-inspired clothing that supports the scene without becoming an identity signal.
clothing.test_configuration: Soft ivory blouse with restrained blue-gray detailing and a modest dark skirt; realistic fabric, natural fit, no exaggerated accessories.
clothing.variation_policy: Clothing may vary across dataset samples while face, body proportions, and age presentation remain stable.

scene.decision: Use a quiet sunlit interior with understated romantic atmosphere and uncluttered background.
scene.test_configuration: Japanese-inspired room with pale wood, translucent curtains, and soft natural window light.
scene.variation_policy: Scene, background, season, and lighting may vary independently from identity.

pose_camera.decision: Use a natural three-quarter standing portrait with relaxed shoulders, balanced weight distribution, and direct but gentle eye contact.
pose_camera.camera: Eye-level medium portrait, three-quarter angle, moderate focal length, no facial distortion.
pose_camera.variation_policy: Permit front, three-quarter, and profile views; seated and standing poses; close, medium, and environmental framing, provided anatomy and identity remain stable.

negative_requirements: brown, black, or light hair replacing dark blue-black hair
missing, fused, duplicated, or extra fingers
missing, fused, duplicated, or extra toes
accidental signature accessories or background identity cues

director.decision: Coordinate identity first, then task locks, anatomy, pose and camera, clothing and scene, lighting and style, and decorative detail.
director.integration_result: Character identity remains the controlling variable while clothing, scene, pose, camera, expression, and lighting provide dataset diversity.
director.handoff_gate: Only assets passing identity, proportion, anatomy, and style checks may proceed to dataset acceptance.

locked_constraints: Adult age presentation must remain approximately 20
Recognizable face, face structure, major facial features, and core facial proportions must remain stable
Dark blue-black hair and blue eyes are identity-critical
Intended body proportions must remain stable
Anatomy hard gate: plausible five-finger hands and five-toe bare feet
No extra, missing, fused, or duplicated digits
No extra limbs, impossible joints, severe deformation, or implausible balance
Skin must remain natural and translucent rather than plastic
Style must remain romantic, refined, dreamy, Japanese-inspired, and anatomically believable
Dataset diversity must not introduce accidental identity signals
Any repaired asset requires a complete recheck before acceptance

hairstyle: Low tie or understated half-up style
Natural shoulder-length variation while retaining color and facial visibility
clothing: Refined light cardigan over a simple top
scene: Minimalist studio with soft translucent backdrop
camera: Environmental portrait with moderate background context

notes: Integrated production specification passes the character and director consistency test.
Variation is intentional across hairstyle, clothing, scene, pose, camera, expression, lighting, and composition; identity-critical traits remain locked.
Final rendered assets must be visually inspected for identity drift, age drift, hair or eye-color errors, anatomy failures, plastic skin, and accidental recurring outfit or background signals.
GitHub shared memory should record accepted references, repaired assets, rejected failure modes, and final validation outcomes.
